findings.title: FIFA (Fédération Internationale de Football Association) listed by handsome boy hacking club ransomware group
findings.summary_md: OffSet7 recorded Handsome Boy Hacking Club's FIFA leak-site listing on 20 November 2026, showing an active countdown with a deadline of 2026-11-20T23:00:00Z. The page explicitly described the entry as the threat group's own claim, said it had not been independently verified, and did not host or link to leaked data. It also listed group claims against Frontier Communications, UCHealth and Smith & Wesson dated 19 November 2026.

findings.title: New cybercrime group threatens FIFA with data leak over ransom
findings.summary_md: Escudo Digital reported on 21 November 2026 that Handsome Boy Hacking Club had added FIFA to its dark-web leaks page and was demanding a ransom within a few days. At publication, the group had shared no screenshots, data categories or theft volume, and neither FIFA nor independent sources had confirmed a breach. The report noted prior false FIFA-related extortion claims and a June streaming-platform access-control patch without linking either to this group. It also said HBHC had recently targeted Frontier Communications, UCHealth and Smith & Wesson.
